propositions: TestClient entering the review-bot ASGI lifespan inherits the production 1200-second shutdown drain timeout, causing tests to hang or run for extended periods instead of completing promptly

The default test fixture must bound SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS to 1.0 seconds globally and stub the reconcile_loop and snapshot janitor background tasks to prevent real reconciliation or cleanup during ordinary tests
A test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS override (e.g., 0.1) must take precedence over the suite-wide 1.0 baseline, enabling tests to control their own drain behavior when needed
Marked tests must be able to opt into the real production reconcile_loop while keeping the 1-second drain bound, proving the production behavior remains available and deterministic

The production DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS constant must remain exactly 1200 seconds unchanged, and test-specific overrides in separate modules (e.g., retrigger) must retain their explicit local drain values
